text:
maya: Quick ask — can someone run a latency + memory profile for galaxy-7b-v2 on the nightly dedicated pool? Seeing p50 creep on short prompts vs baseline. Need per-layer GPU mem and attention kernel timings. Hoping for results by EOD.

liam: On it — pinging @evan for the profiling script. Do you want short prompts only or also some long tails?

maya: Short prompts (<=64) primarily, plus a few 512-token tails to check p95. Use the prompt set 'llm_sanity_v2' in s3://redwood-benchmarks/sets/galaxy. Capture nvprof/kcache and perf traces if possible.

evan: Got it. I'll run on g5dedicated1 (A100x) and upload profs to /artifacts/1976543210_galaxy. Running with perf-sweep.sh — should I run with continuous batching on AND off?

liam: Yes, run both. Also do kv-cache warm and cold runs. Batch sizes 1,2,4 is enough.

sara: Quick heads up — dedicated pool maintenance starts at 23:00 UTC, avoid starting runs after 22:30. ETA for uploads?

infra-bot: Scheduled job created: job-8791. Started 1976543238. Logs: https://internal-ci/jobs/8791

evan: Started capture now. First pass looks similar but i'll post a short summary in ~15m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

liam: If anything looks like a regression, tag @eng-runtime and open a perf/regress ticket.

evan: Upload complete: /artifacts/1976543210_galaxy/profiles.tar.gz. Quick summary: short prompts p50 increased ~8% vs galaxy-7b-v1, tail p95 roughly unchanged. Memory: attention scratch increased ~120MB on layers 9-12. Kernel timings show fallback to generic attention kernels on some shapes.

maya: Thanks. Can you paste the exact command you ran so we can reproduce?

evan: Command:
```
./perf-sweep.sh --model galaxy-7b-v2 --pool g5dedicated1 --prompts llm_sanity_v2 --batch-sizes '1,2,4' --seq-lens '16,64,512' --kv-warm --run-both-batching
```
Artifacts: https://s3.redwood/artifacts/1976543210_galaxy/profiles.tar.gz

liam: Assigning follow-up: @sara please double-check kernel selection heuristics and try forcing the optimized flash-attn path to confirm. @evan can try targeted layer runs.

sara: On it — I'll force flash-attn kernel and run a layer-targeted check for 9-12 and report back.

evan: Ran targeted kernel test. Forcing flash-attn on layers 9-12 dropped p50 back to baseline. So root cause looks like kernel selection fallback for this model shape.

maya: Great find. Let's add a note to the onboarding doc marking galaxy-7b-v2 as 'kernel-hint recommended' until runtime heuristics are updated. Also create a small canary that forces flash-attn for now.

liam: :thumbsup: I'll open the runtime PR with a model hint, add the canary config, and create the regression ticket. Quick TODOs: PR, canary, perf/regress issue.

sara: Will update here with rerun numbers once done.
